fact_english: Young Philippine sailfin lizards can run short distances across the surface of water; adults get too heavy to do it.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang batang ibid, ang Philippine sailfin lizard, kayang tumakbo sa ibabaw ng tubig, saglit lang!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Pag tumanda at bumigat, lulubog na. Parang ako pagkatapos ng Pasko.

why_here: After Usman's 'Par, ano'ng nangyari sa'yo?': the question hangs over the break.
